barks.text: Ow. Okay, that one was personal.
Hacking time. Nobody touch my console.
Yippee-ki-yay, Kessler-Voss. Thanks for the ore.
Jackpot! Mama needs a new gun.
Pick one. Try not to overthink.
Console drop confirmed. Try not to lose it.
Shuttle down. Boarding window is short.
Well. That was a very expensive nap.
Signal lost. I will file a complaint.

alerts.text: Kessler-Voss Smart Consoles: innovation, delivered straight to your doorstep!
Unauthorized console retrieval will be logged under Form 27-B.
Surprise! A Kessler-Voss Rewards Crate has arrived for valued guests!
Cargo crate unclaimed. Contents remain company property pending review.
Security response dispatched. Compliance is mandatory and appreciated.
Kessler-Voss Safety Team is coming to meet you!
Your premium departure experience awaits. Thank you for visiting!
Departure window closing. Late exits will be processed as trespass.

upgrade_texts.flavor: Say hello to my little friend, but louder.
Go ahead, make my day. Repeatedly.
Feeling lucky, punk? Because I do.
That one is gonna leave a mark, buddy.
I'll be back. Eventually. Sturdier, too.
Get to the choppa, but I'm already there.
Loot comes to me. Magnets, baby.
